$comment: AUTHORED. The display name a GitHub App installer approves does not determine the wire slug that `default_permissions` accepts, and GitHub publishes no mapping between them. These are the correspondences established by hand; everything else is left to naive normalization, and whatever that fails to resolve is reported as unresolved by gh-permission-reconcile.mjs rather than guessed. The unresolved set is the work item (.github#104) -- do not close it by inventing entries here. Each addition should be justified the way these are.

organization/Blocking users.why: noun order reversed; naive normalization yields organization_blocking_users

organization/Custom organization roles.why: 'organization' abbreviated to 'org' in the slug only. Note the wire also carries organization_custom_roles, which no display name claims -- see orphans

organization/Members.why: an organization permission whose slug carries NO organization_ prefix. This is the case that makes prefix-as-plane unsound

repository/Custom properties.why: repository plane carries an explicit repository_ prefix here, though most repository slugs carry none

repository/Webhooks.why: 'webhooks' -> 'hooks', with the repository_ prefix that most repository slugs lack
